executor_profile.justification: Mechanical-but-structural refactor (remove hand-copy, wire a callable contract surface, add a lint and a corpus differential test) with a well-specified, testable done-state; no open-ended judgment call or adversarial design work that would justify opus. High effort because it touches a validator relied on fleet-wide and must not regress existing card-validation behavior. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.

source_artifact.content_excerpt: The structural fix behind the 343-card disaster: abolish copies rather than police them -- versioned CLI/plugin contract surface, a lint banning local mirrors, and a real-card verdict corpus locking the validator's behavior, not just its bytes.
source_artifact.title: Forbid hand-copied validators: consumers exec the source-of-truth surface; behavior locked by a real-card corpus
